messages.author: 83aa4ea66d984b54
messages.subject: Getting StataStan v3.0-ready
parts:
Hello folks

I am preparing to send Stata commands 'stan' and 'windowsmonitor', which comprise StataStan, to the Stata repository SSC. There a few fairly minor things to do first which you can see on the github to-do list. But then it also occurs to me, upon reading the thread on service models, that I should get consistent with some of the argument names, like 'iter' or 'mode'. So, I'd rather do that now than have to change names after an 'official' release. These are the Stata options - any suggestions for changes?

options Description
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Main
datafile(filename) destination text file for data on their way to Stan
modelfile(filename) .stan file containing the Stan model, or location of text file
into which the model will be written
inline read the .stan model from a comment block insid ethe do-file
thisfile(filename) the name (and path, if required) of the current do-file, if inline
has been specified (see Remarks)
initsfile(filename) text file in R / S-plus format containing initial values
diagnose run Stan's diagnostics
outputfile(filename)
destination text file for Stan outputs
chainfile(filename) destination for Stan chains in CSV format
mode run Stan's optimization to find posterior modes
modesfile(filename) destination text file for Stan estimation of modes
winlogfile(filename)
temporary file to hold Windows output (see windowsmonitor)
seed random number generator seed for Stan
warmup(integer) number of warmup iterations
iter(integer) number of iterations to retain after warmup
thin(integer) thinning of iterations: retain one out of every thin
skipmissing remove missing data observation-wise before sending to Stan
matrices(string) list of matrices to send to Stan, or "all" to send all current
matrices
globals(string) list of globals to send to Stan, or "all" to send all current
global macros
